outcome: Meeting the National Minimum Standard (NMS) cut-off in literacy and numeracy domains (educational outcomes)
cohort: Liveborn infants in New South Wales, Australia, born at >=24 weeks gestation, with corresponding standardized school test results for grade 3 between 2008-2014.
finding: The educational disadvantage experienced by twins compared to singletons is primarily attributable to shorter gestational age and, to a lesser extent, poor foetal growth.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age; Poor foetal growth
